I recently purchased the Liber Primus paperback book online and wanted to give a quick overview, so here it is: ''[if you have any additional questions on the actual book, go to the Talk page]''
- I had some strange markings on the cover, you can't really see them unless you view the book cover at an angle with light, such markings as ''''X = G'''' and ''''AllAroundUs''''
- There was a signature written in pen, I can't really read what it says (it's in cursive but the message is gibberish) on the inside of the cover. At the bottom of the signature it read: '''"- Divinity: 1, 32"'''
- I don't know if this is how the pages are supposed to go or how they are but it seems out of order. I never got the page that read 'Chapter one - Intus' or something like that but the warning is halfway into the back of the book. I thought maybe the warning would be in the beggining?
''[if you have any additional questions on the actual book, go to the Talk page]''
